enchantments.tooltip: Draconic Ferocity: While an Epic-level Helm of the Black Dragon is equipped at the same time as a Flawless Black Dragonscale Armor, you will gain a +3% artifact bonus to melee Doublestrike chance and a +2 artifact bonus to damage with ranged or thrown weapons.

enchantments.text: One of the following ability bonuses:

children.tooltip: Constitution +8: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Insightful Constitution +3: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Dexterity +8: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Insightful Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
Strength +8: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Insightful Strength +3: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Strength.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
